notes: List year: 2026/27 (the 2027/28 call was not yet published on 14 November 2026; the programme lists of 2027/28 will replace these).

Programmes recorded from the official Excel annex of the 2026/27 call (distinct programme names per study level, not per university): bachelor 107, master 223 (including 9 one-tier master's programmes: Architecture, Pharmacy, Medicine, Dentistry, Veterinary Medicine, Painting, Sculpture, Graphic Arts, Intermedia Art), doctorate 124, diploma level 11 (10 postgraduate specialist training courses and the one-year Preparatory Course in Hungarian Language). Total 465. The full-degree annex has 464 rows (BA 105, MA 214, one-tier master's 9, PhD 124, postgraduate 10, preparatory 1); the partial-studies annex has 187 rows, of which 185 also appear in the full-degree list and 2 appear only in the partial list (Balkan Studies BA, Human Ecology BA), which are recorded with a note.

The call states about 900 foreign-language programmes at bachelor, master and one-tier level and about 170 doctoral programmes. These counts are programme offerings per university, language and mode; the Excel annex lists each programme name once per study level, so it has fewer rows. Several universities offer the same programme name.
Programme names for doctoral level are the doctoral school and programme names exactly as the official annex gives them.

Availability per sending country (yes/no columns in the annex) was not copied: the annex says which programmes each partner country may choose; applicants must check their own country in the annex or on the partners page.

Host institutions with the number of programmes the official online application system shows for each (all levels, languages and modes; institutions with no programme count shown are left out; the main site speaks of 30 host institutions in the call): Budapest Metropolitan University (6), Budapest University of Economics and Business (11), Budapest University of Technology and Economics (80), Corvinus University of Budapest (42), Eötvös Loránd University (139), Hungarian Dance University (5), Hungarian University of Fine Arts (7), Hungarian University of Sports Science (11), John Wesley Theological College (3), Károli Gáspár University of the Reformed Church in Hungary (12), Liszt Ferenc Academy of Music (19), Ludovika University of Public Service (16), MFA Balassi Preparatory Programme (1), Moholy-Nagy University of Art and Design Budapest (6), Obuda University (31), Pázmány Péter Catholic University (26), Semmelweis University (26), University of Veterinary Medicine Budapest (3), University of Debrecen (105), University of Dunaújváros (13), Eszterházy Károly Catholic University (33), Széchenyi István University (57), Hungarian University of Agriculture and Life Sciences (MATE) (91), John von Neumann University (10), University of Miskolc (59), University of Nyíregyháza (18), University of Pécs (151), University of Sopron (16), University of Szeged (92), Sárospatak Reformed Theological University (2), Edutus University (3), University of Pannonia (40).
not_stated: The official Excel annexes and the calls do not say which Hungarian university offers which programme; that pairing is only in the online application system's search, a JavaScript search that was not used.
No cap or total of programme names per level is stated in the annex.
fetch_problems: Per-university programme pairing (programme with its Hungarian university, language and duration) lives only in the JavaScript programme search of the online application system; it was not scraped, so institution is left empty for the rows. The official annexes were used instead.
The study finder page on the main Stipendium Hungaricum site returned no list of programmes (it points to the online application system).
